method: Unedited screenshot of a local read-only production build of Decision Lab served on loopback. The local source build is not asserted to be identical to the public deployment. All external network requests were blocked. A baseline fictional portable case was imported and its expenseLimit changed using the ordinary YAML editor. No UI text or results were injected; no shared publication occurred.
actions: Import baseline earliest-arrival-shipment.app-case.json using Published apps → Import app, workflow or case.
Choose Both in Workspace layout to reveal the case YAML beside the report.
In Canonical commitment case YAML, replace expenseLimit: 650000 with expenseLimit: 500000; leave all other values alone.
Wait for Reports current and Saved locally. Valid YAML updates reports automatically; Run calculation also reruns the valid case.
Choose Reports in Workspace layout. Verify direct is preferred and backup is blocked.
Export case and verify its exact immutable app package and changed-only case inputs.
Import the exported changed case in a separate fresh context and verify the direct preference again.
